{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop the six QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
df = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Drop refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Filter for new customers reached by paid_search
df_new_paid_search = df[(df['channel'] == 'paid_search') & (df['customer_segment'] == 'new')]

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of converted orders
total_new_paid_search = len(df_new_paid_search)
converted_new_paid_search = df_new_paid_search['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate = converted_new_paid_search / total_new_paid_search

# Print result
conversion_rate"}
